name: smoove
label: Smoove
description: Smoove is a platform for creating and managing your email list and sending emails to your subscribers.

addOrUpdateSubscriber.label: Add or Update Subscriber
addOrUpdateSubscriber.description: Create or update subscriber data, and subscribe/unsubscribe from lists

email.label: Email Address
email.description: Select an existing contact email or type a new one

firstName.label: First Name
firstName.description: The first name of the contact

lastName.label: Last Name
lastName.description: The last name of the contact

dateOfBirth.label: Date of Birth
dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the contact

phone.label: Phone Number
phone.description: The primary phone number of the contact

cellPhone.label: Cell Phone
cellPhone.description: The cell phone number of the contact

address.label: Address
address.description: The street address of the contact

company.label: Company
company.description: The company name of the contact

position.label: Position
position.description: The job title or position of the contact

externalId.label: External ID
externalId.description: External identifier for the contact (useful for syncing with other systems)

campaignSource.label: Campaign Source
campaignSource.description: The campaign source that brought this contact

canReceiveEmails.label: Can Receive Emails
canReceiveEmails.description: Whether the contact can receive email communications

canReceiveSmsMessages.label: Can Receive SMS
canReceiveSmsMessages.description: Whether the contact can receive SMS messages

lists.label: Lists
lists.description: Select lists to subscribe the contact to

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Custom fields data (JSON object with field IDs as keys)

createAList.label: Create a List
createAList.description: Create a new mailing list with custom settings and descriptions

name.label: List Name
name.description: The name of the list to be created

description.label: Description
description.description: Internal description of the list for your reference
description.defaultValue: This list is a list for new subscribers

publicName.label: Public Name
publicName.description: The public-facing name of the list visible to subscribers

publicDescription.label: Public Description
publicDescription.description: Public description of the list visible to subscribers
publicDescription.defaultValue: Public name - This list is a list for new subscribers

allowsUsersToSubscribe.label: Allow Users to Subscribe
allowsUsersToSubscribe.description: Allow users to subscribe to this list themselves

allowsUsersToUnsubscribe.label: Allow Users to Unsubscribe
allowsUsersToUnsubscribe.description: Allow users to unsubscribe from this list themselves

isPortal.label: Is Portal
isPortal.description: Enable portal access for this list

unsubscribe.label: Unsubscribe Subscriber
unsubscribe.description: Unsubscribe a contact from all lists and move them to the "Unsubscribed" list
